第1979章 都要急死了（第1页）
王圆圆的都要着急死了，这还真的是皇帝不急太监急。
这个当事人都不着急结婚，她一做伴娘的，却着急的要命。
那恐怕就真的好玩了，这可能就会是明日海城头条了。
君雅思也着急，但是此刻在怎么着急也是没有办法，只有脚下的步子不断的加快。
好在顾少卿早有准备，在君雅思走出基地的时候，他的车子就已经出现在了基地的门口。
而且还是一辆保姆车，这为的就是她能够在车上换衣服化妆。
君雅思一上车就有化妆师给她化妆打理头发。而且化妆师跟造型师，还是海城最顶级的造型团队。
所以，在车上化妆做造型，这对于他们来说，有点难度都没有。
君雅思乘着人家拿眼影的空档，看了一眼正望着她的顾少卿。
想要确定自己是不是看错了，想要再次看去的时候，化妆师已经要她闭上眼睛开始画眼妆了。
这样一来，自己想要在看一看的事情就落了空。
她闭着眼睛，实在是想要弄清楚他是不是因为要跟自己结婚了，反倒是在害羞这件事情，最后索性直接问了出来。
她的这话一出，车厢里所有的人皆是一愣，显然没有想到君雅思会突然这样说。
几乎是下意识的，所有人的视线都看向了顾少卿。
顾少卿其实就是紧张，但是此刻被君雅思说成是害羞，他也是无奈了。
他的神色恢复了正常，所有的情绪尽数内敛，那些人想要窥视他此刻的情绪，也无法得到半点。
顾少卿这些年纵横商场那么多年，早已练就了情绪收放自如了。
也只有在君雅思的面前，他的情绪才会更多样化，也从不深藏着。
其他人见顾少卿与以前一样，也都没有在说什么，继续开始忙碌自己的。
从基地到结婚的场地，大概要一个小时。
而这个小时，君雅思化妆造型换衣服，也差不多能弄好。
等到王圆圆接到新娘子的时候，也都松了口气。
这场婚礼，大多都是王圆圆他们三个商量的，虽然出现的是顾少卿，但是更多的想法是她们三个。
到底认识那么多年的闺蜜，对于君雅思喜欢什么，她们可是了若指掌的。
因此，这婚礼的场地是个什么样子，君雅思是一点都不知道，因为她没参与过，所以对婚礼的现场，可也是蛮期待的。
之前还没有到这里，她的情绪还能够很平静的面对，但是此刻到了场地的外面，她反倒是紧张了。
顾少卿朝她走了过来，将她的手给握在掌心。
只是他刚刚将君雅思的手给牵着，就已经被王圆圆给抢了过去。
“不行，你个新郎官，不应该在这里，走走走……”
在学校时代的时候，她崇拜顾少卿的不得了，男神之中的男神。

Chapter 1979 I’m almost dying of anxiety (page 1)
Wang Yuanyuan was worried to death. This really meant that the emperor was not anxious and the eunuch was.
This client was not in a hurry to get married, but she was extremely anxious when she became the bridesmaid.
That might be really fun, and it might be the headline in Haicheng tomorrow.
Jun Yasi was also anxious, but no matter how anxious he was at this moment, there was nothing he could do. He could only speed up his steps.
Fortunately, Gu Shaoqing was prepared. When Jun Yasi walked out of the base, his car had already appeared at the entrance of the base.
It is also a nanny car so that she can change clothes and put on makeup in the car.
As soon as Jun Yasi got in the car, a makeup artist put makeup on her and took care of her hair. Moreover, the makeup artists and stylists are the top styling team in Haicheng.
Therefore, it is not difficult for them to apply makeup and styling in the car.
Jun Yasi took advantage of the opportunity when people were taking eye shadow and glanced at Gu Shaoqing who was looking at her.
When she wanted to make sure she had seen it wrong and wanted to look again, the makeup artist had already asked her to close her eyes and start applying eye makeup.
In this way, what I wanted to see would be in vain.
She closed her eyes, really trying to figure out if he was shy about marrying her, so she finally asked directly.
As soon as she said these words, everyone in the carriage was stunned, obviously not expecting Jun Yasi to say this suddenly.
Almost subconsciously, everyone looked at Gu Shaoqing.
Gu Shaoqing was actually nervous, but now that Jun Yasi said he was shy, he was helpless.
His expression returned to normal, and all his emotions were restrained. Those who wanted to peek into his emotions at this moment could not get the slightest glimpse.
Gu Shaoqing has been in the shopping mall for so many years and has already developed the ability to control his emotions freely.
Only in front of Jun Yasi, his emotions will be more diverse and he will never hide them deeply.
Seeing that Gu Shaoqing was the same as before, the others didn't say anything and continued to work on their own.
It takes about an hour from the base to the wedding venue.
And during this hour, Jun Yasi could almost finish putting on makeup and changing clothes.
When Wang Yuanyuan received the bride, she was relieved.
This wedding was mostly discussed by Wang Yuanyuan and the others. Although it was Gu Shaoqing who showed up, the three of them were more on the mind.
After all, best friends who have known each other for so many years know exactly what Jun Yasi likes.
Therefore, Jun Yasi had no idea what the wedding venue was like, because she had never participated in it, so she was quite looking forward to the wedding venue.
Before arriving here, she could face it calmly, but now that she was outside the venue, she was actually nervous.
Gu Shaoqing walked towards her and held her hand in his palm.
But just as he held Jun Yasi's hand, Wang Yuanyuan snatched her away.
"No, you, a groom, shouldn't be here, walk around..."
When she was in school, she admired Gu Shaoqing very much, he was the god among male gods.
